SELECT s.id, e.id AS employee_id, s.base_salary, s.post_allowance, s.other_allowance, s.perf_bonus_base, s.social_base, s.housing_base, s.housing_rate, s.bank_name, s.bank_account, s.remark, s.update_time, e.emp_no, e.name AS employee_name, d.name AS dept_name, p.name AS position_name, e.status AS emp_status FROM hr_employee e LEFT JOIN hr_salary s ON s.employee_id = e.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE e.status <> 'LEFT'
AND (e.emp_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR e.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND e.dept_id IN #{d}
AND s.id IS NULL ORDER BY e.emp_no
SELECT s.* FROM hr_salary s JOIN hr_employee e ON e.id = s.employee_id JOIN hr_position p ON p.id = e.position_id WHERE e.status <> 'LEFT' AND p.category = 'PRODUCTION'
